snippet.title: Possible One: Lunar Industries | Official Early Access Trailer (ns)
snippet.description:
Hello, Commander. The future of humanity begins with you in Possible One: Lunar Industries!

You are entrusted with humanity’s first true lunar colony, where every decision shapes survival as you build the foundations of life beyond Earth, manage your colonists, and use real-world technologies to expand, mine resources, and protect your crew from the harsh realities of the moon.

Scheduled for Early Access release on May 22, 2026!

Wishlist Possible One: Lunar Industries on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2276770/Possible_One_Lunar_Industries/ 
Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/possible
Check out the Upstairs Games website: https://www.upstairsgames.com
